Convert an iconic_data object to a MultiAssayExperiment

Source: R/mae.R
as_MultiAssayExperiment.Rd

Exports the standardised analysis data held in an iconic_data object as a MultiAssayExperiment::MultiAssayExperiment, the Bioconductor container for multi-omic data on shared samples. Use it to store, share, subset, or inspect the exact data an ICONIC analysis was run on with standard Bioconductor tools. The result can be passed straight back to as_iconic_data() (the role mapping is recorded in the metadata).

Usage

as_MultiAssayExperiment(data)

Arguments

data

An iconic_data object (from iconic_data() or as_iconic_data()).

Value

A MultiAssayExperiment with

experiments

SummarizedExperiments (assay value, features x samples) named Y (outcome panel; continuous outcomes only), M (mediators), Gm (mediator instruments), W, W1, W2 (negative-control panels), each present only when supplied.

colData

X (exposure), G (exposure instrument), surv_time / surv_event (survival), Y_bin (binary outcome), and the encoded covariates (prefixed cov_ if a name collides).

metadata

iconic: the outcome type, scaling parameters, feature / mediator names, availability flags, the role mapping used by as_iconic_data(), and the attached GAN (if any).

Values are those stored in data, i.e. centred and scaled when iconic_data(scale = TRUE) (the default); original-scale parameters are kept in metadata(mae)$iconic$scaling.

Examples

d <- iconic_data(X = rnorm(60), Y = matrix(rnorm(60 * 5), 5, 60),
    M = rnorm(60), G = rnorm(60), Gm = rnorm(60),
    W = matrix(rnorm(60 * 5), 5, 60))
mae <- as_MultiAssayExperiment(d)
mae
#> A MultiAssayExperiment object of 4 listed
#>  experiments with user-defined names and respective classes.
#>  Containing an ExperimentList class object of length 4:
#>  [1] Y: SummarizedExperiment with 5 rows and 60 columns
#>  [2] M: SummarizedExperiment with 1 rows and 60 columns
#>  [3] Gm: SummarizedExperiment with 1 rows and 60 columns
#>  [4] W: SummarizedExperiment with 5 rows and 60 columns
#> Functionality:
#>  experiments() - obtain the ExperimentList instance
#>  colData() - the primary/phenotype DataFrame
#>  sampleMap() - the sample coordination DataFrame
#>  `$`, `[`, `[[` - extract colData columns, subset, or experiment
#>  *Format() - convert into a long or wide DataFrame
#>  assays() - convert ExperimentList to a SimpleList of matrices
#>  exportClass() - save data to flat files
d2 <- as_iconic_data(mae) # round trip
all.equal(d$Y, d2$Y, check.attributes = FALSE)
#> [1] TRUE
